name: Roselyne Fran
source: After her previous adventures, she transitioned from being a spiritist serving the Kingdom of Influss to becoming the accountant responsible for the finances of the Guaracuna Trading Company. Her primary focus is to assist Avaro, and she appears to be content with her current life. Upon moving to the fortress, she discovered that she has a tendency towards gambling, but as an accountant, she exercises self-restraint. She exudes an air of elegance, giving the impression that she was raised in an upper-class household, and speaks eloquently. However, she has a habit of concealing her emotions and keeping her worries and circumstances to herself. Due to not being allowed to go out without permission, she is not accustomed to interacting with others, but she is now displaying her own proactiveness.
